name: 小翼龙
description: 身形圆润可爱，翼膜十分柔软，只能在陆地上漂浮。植食性，最爱啃蕨类与低矮灌木，进食的时候总是呛到，猜测是因为呼吸系统还没有发育完全，需要用嘴巴呼吸。
descriptionEn: Round and cute in shape, its wing membranes are very soft and it can only float above the ground. Herbivorous, it loves to gnaw on ferns and low shrubs, and always chokes while eating—presumably because its respiratory system is not yet fully developed and it needs to breathe through its mouth.
